name: Black-headed Parrotbill
rangeDescription: Eastern cambodia and highlands of southern vietnam (southern annam)
description: A large, black-capped parrotbill restricted to southern Annam in Vietnam and adjacent areas of Cambodia. Similar in general shape and color scheme to Gray-headed Parrotbill (no range overlap) but with an indistinct dark cheek patch, warmer coloration, and no bold black stripes on the face.

name: Luzon Redstart
rangeDescription: Rocky streams of northern luzon (northern philippines)
description: A fairly small bird of fast-flowing streams through foothill and montane forest or scrub. Slaty-blue with a rufous belly and tail.

name: Chestnut-colored Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Gulf-caribbean slope of southern mexico (southern veracruz) to western panama
description: Attractive, medium-sized crested woodpecker of humid tropical lowlands. Uncommon in evergreen forest and edge ranging into adjacent clearings with taller trees.

name: Flores Heleia
rangeDescription: Western lesser sundas (flores and sumbawa)
description: A gray-and-white songbird with a diagnostic head pattern. Dark olive above and clean white below, with dark cheeks that contrast with the conspicuous pale eye and a white forehead bleeding into dark speckles on the crown.

name: Cundinamarca Antpitta
rangeDescription: Eastern andes of colombia (cundinamarca and meta)
description: A rather plain antpitta known only from a small area of Colombia’s eastern Andes, southeast of Bogotá. Plumage is dull brown with small white streaks on the underparts, a slightly paler belly, and a faint eyering.

name: Sandy Gallito
rangeDescription: Andean slope of argentina (southwestern salta to río negro)
description: Plain brown thrush-sized bird of the Monte desert region of western Argentina. Note shorter, thicker bill than canasteros, miners and thornbirds.

name: Parker's Spinetail
rangeDescription: River islands in amazon system from eastern brazil to eastern peru
description: Rusty above with pale brown underparts, a whitish throat, and a long spiky tail. Occurs on shrubby river islands favoring early successional vegetation.

name: Gray-fronted Quail-Dove
rangeDescription: Cuba (rare)
description: A multicolored chunky dove of dense, wet forests with thick leaf-litter. It is most often found on the ground, sometimes in association with Blue-headed or Ruddy Quail-Doves.

name: Red-capped Coua
rangeDescription: Lowlands of northwestern madagascar
description: Long-tailed, long-legged understory bird with a reddish cap. Found in dry deciduous forest at low elevations in western Madagascar.

name: Merida Wren
rangeDescription: Andes of northwestern venezuela (trujillo and mérida)
description: Small, barred wren of the high paramo. Eyebrow whitish; upperparts, flanks, wings, and tail barred.

name: Northern Cassowary
rangeDescription: Lowlands of new guinea, including raja ampat islands (off western new guinea) and yapen (cenderawasih bay, off northwestern new guinea)
description: An enormous flightless bird of lowland rainforest. Shaggy black plumage, blue head and bright red or yellow around the base of the neck.

name: Mandarin Duck
rangeDescription: Wooded ponds, swamps, and streams of northeastern asia from southeastern siberia, korean peninsula, japan, and eastern china
description: Small exotic-looking duck found at lakes and parks, usually with nearby trees. Male very ornate with big orangey

name: Giant Wren
rangeDescription: Humid pacific lowlands of southern mexico (chiapas)
description: Very large wren restricted to coastal plain of Chiapas and adjacent Guatemala. Favors open and semiopen areas with hedges, scattered large trees, stone walls, and thickets; often in and around villages and in gardens of small farms.

name: Mulga Parrot
rangeDescription: Interior of southern australia (western western australia to central new south wales)
description: Medium-sized colorful parrot, widespread across more arid and semi-arid woodlands of southern inland Australia. Adult male very brightly colored and striking in appearance, primarily turquoise-green with dark blue and yellow in the wings and yellow and red in lower belly.

name: Long-tailed Reed Finch
rangeDescription: Northern bolivia to southeastern paraguay, southeastern brazil, uruguay, and northeastern argentina
description: Small finch with a very long tail and a pointed bill. Note the well-marked eyebrow and mustache giving it an angry-looking face.

name: Black-crowned Pitta
rangeDescription: Lowlands of northern borneo
description: Dazzling pitta of Borneo’s lowland dipterocarp forests. Midnight blue above and blinding scarlet below, with a dark head, bright blue wing coverts, and a glowing silver line trailing backwards behind the eye.

name: Japanese Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Japan (honshu to tanegashima and offshore islands)
description: The only green-backed woodpecker in the region, found in deciduous and evergreen broadleaf forests in mountains. Plumage unmistakable, with green upperparts and numerous neat spots on the belly.

name: Malaita White-eye
rangeDescription: Malaita (central solomon islands)
description: Small. Olive-green above with a yellow belly and vent.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: New Caledonian Streaked Fantail
rangeDescription: New caledonia, including lifou, and maré islands (loyalty islands)
description: Small, with a long, often fanned tail. Mostly reddish-brown with a grayish-brown head, a white eyebrow and cheek stripes, and a white throat and chest finely marked with black arrowheads.

name: Trilling Shrike-Babbler
rangeDescription: Highlands of western java
description: Adorable stout little yellowish bird of Java’s foothill and montane forests. Male is unique, with bright yellow underparts, flashing black-and-white wingbars, dark lores, and a deep rust-red throat.
